lead.headline: SEC custody overhaul reaches White House as Kalshi raises $1.12B, signaling regulatory and prediction-market infrastructure maturing in parallel
lead.tldr: The Atkins-led SEC is advancing a structural custody rewrite while Kalshi's $1.12 billion raise and $40 billion target valuation show prediction-market infrastructure commanding institutional-scale capital commitments. The throughline: regulated financial plumbing and crypto-native collateral mechanisms are hardening simultaneously, narrowing the gap between tradfi onboarding rails and native asset utility.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today the regulatory pipeline, prediction-market capital formation, and Bitcoin collateralization all moved in ways that reshape how we underwrite infrastructure versus application-layer bets for the next twelve months.

top_signals.title: SEC sends crypto custody rule overhaul to White House for review
top_signals.summary: The SEC has sent a proposed overhaul of its decades-old custody requirements to the White House for review. This move, pushed by Paul Atkins, aims to provide clearer regulatory frameworks for the custody of digital assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Atkins SEC sending custody rules to the White House begins a measurable clock on when institutional digital asset custody becomes a defined, licensable activity rather than a legal gray zone that drives compliance costs and counterparty selection.

top_signals.title: Kalshi raised $1.12 billion via private equity offering since April, latest SEC filing shows
top_signals.summary: Kalshi has raised $1.12 billion through private equity offerings since April, according to recent SEC filings. The company is reportedly seeking an additional $750 million in capital at a $40 billion valuation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Kalshi's $1.12 billion since April and pursuit of $40 billion valuation demonstrates that regulated prediction-market infrastructure now clears the same capital thresholds as major fintechs, repricing what 'alternative asset platform' means for liquidity and exit timelines.

top_signals.title: First quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction successfully executed, StarkWare says
top_signals.summary: StarkWare has successfully executed the first quantum-resistant Bitcoin transaction. While a milestone, the company notes that a full protocol-level upgrade is still required to ensure Bitcoin's long-term safety against quantum computing threats.
top_signals.why_it_matters: StarkWare's quantum-resistant transaction is a proof-of-concept that does not yet alter Bitcoin's risk profile, but it establishes a credible technical path that changes how long-duration holders and treasury managers should model tail-risk horizons.

top_signals.title: Better launches Bitcoin-backed mortgages powered by Coinbase15m, Better launches Bitcoin-backed mortgages powered by CoinbaseBetter and Coinbase have launched a crypto-backed mortgage product that lets US homebuyers pledge Bitcoin as collateral for a down payment without having to sell it.
top_signals.summary: Better and Coinbase have introduced a new mortgage product for US homebuyers that allows Bitcoin to be used as collateral for down payments. This enables users to secure home loans without liquidating their BTC holdings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Better and Coinbase's Bitcoin-backed mortgage product converts BTC from a balance-sheet asset into a collateral layer for the largest consumer credit market, directly testing whether crypto-native collateral can price competitively against traditional down-payment structures.

top_signals.title: Taurus links digital asset platforms to Swift’s blockchain ledger
top_signals.summary: Taurus has integrated its tokenization and custody platforms with Swift's blockchain ledger. This move allows institutional clients to connect digital asset platforms to the global financial messaging network.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Taurus-Swift integration means tokenized assets now route through the same messaging infrastructure that settles $150 trillion annually, which matters for whether tokenization remains a parallel system or becomes the settlement layer for existing institutional flows.

deals.summary: Kalshi has raised $1.12 billion through private equity offerings since April, according to recent SEC filings. The company is reportedly seeking an additional $750 million in capital at a $40 billion valuation.

RockawayX has acquired Relayer Capital to expand its cryptocurrency service offerings within the United States. Relayer will be rebranded as the RockawayX Liquid Opportunities Fund, focusing on undervalued liquid tokens and crypto-related equities.

on_the_radar.title: Japan weighs blockchain fast lane for securities cash settlement31m, Japan weighs blockchain fast lane for securities cash settlementThe FSA, Finance Ministry, BOJ and financial institutions plan to study the infrastructure and produce a development plan by early 2027.
on_the_radar.summary: Japanese financial authorities, including the FSA and BOJ, are exploring the implementation of blockchain technology to accelerate securities cash settlement. The group aims to study the necessary infrastructure and finalize a development plan by early 2027.

on_the_radar.title: Revolut rolls out euro stablecoin in three European markets27m, Revolut rolls out euro stablecoin in three European marketsThe Bridge-issued EURR token will support multiple blockchains and external wallets, with wider EEA availability expected this year.
on_the_radar.summary: Revolut has launched a euro-denominated stablecoin, EURR, issued by Bridge, across three European markets. The token supports multiple blockchains and external wallets, with plans to expand availability across the European Economic Area (EEA) later this year.

on_the_radar.title: Japan to work on blockchain-based stock settlement system, details expected early 2027: Nikkei
on_the_radar.summary: Japan is planning to develop a blockchain-based system for stock settlement to modernize its financial infrastructure. Detailed plans are expected by early 2027, with the system potentially becoming fully operational by the early 2030s.

on_the_radar.title: US banking groups plan nationwide blockchain network for 2027 BankChain joins a growing field of bank-led networks building shared infrastructure for tokenized deposits and onchain payments.
on_the_radar.summary: US banking groups are collaborating to launch a nationwide blockchain network by 2027. The initiative, including BankChain, aims to create shared infrastructure for onchain payments and tokenized deposits.

on_the_radar.title: Chainalysis estimates $457B in taxable crypto activity, says CARF misses most34m, Chainalysis estimates $457B in taxable crypto activity, says CARF misses mostThe blockchain analytics firm said just 14% of the onchain activity it identified is covered by the OECD’s international crypto tax-reporting framework.
on_the_radar.summary: Chainalysis estimates that taxable crypto activity reached $457 billion, while arguing that the OECD's CARF framework is insufficient. The firm claims only 14% of identified on-chain activity is currently covered by the international reporting standards.

on_the_radar.title: Cambodia’s scam-center underworld linked to Mexico’s Sinaloa Cartel and its cryptocurrency millions
on_the_radar.summary: Authorities have uncovered links between Cambodia's scam-center operations and Mexico's Sinaloa Cartel. The investigation reveals that Southeast Asia is serving as a financial hub for Latin American criminal groups utilizing cryptocurrency to move millions.

on_the_radar.title: Bernstein forecasts Bitcoin to reclaim $125K by late 2026 ahead of cycle peak15m
on_the_radar.summary: Bernstein analysts forecast that Bitcoin will reach $125,000 by late 2026 as it approaches its cycle peak. The prediction is based on institutional adoption and market cycle trends.

on_the_radar.title: Bernstein sees bitcoin reaching $150,000 by mid-2027 amid 'debasement trade,' but cuts Strategy target to $350
on_the_radar.summary: Bernstein forecasts Bitcoin will reach $150,000 by mid-2027 as part of a 'debasement trade,' with a potential cycle peak of $300,000 by 2029. However, the firm has lowered its price target for MicroStrategy (Strategy) to $350.

worth_a_read.title: Evaluating the AI Labs of China
worth_a_read.note: China's AI lab ecosystem is now the primary competitive variable for Western foundation-model economics, and this piece maps which labs are resourced, constrained, or strategically misaligned in ways that reshape global compute and capital allocation.

linkedin_post:
Paul Atkins has been SEC chair for weeks, not years. The custody rewrite is already at the White House. Compare that to the Gensler pace, then ask what else moves fast in this commission.

Kalshi's $1.12 billion since April and a $40 billion target valuation tell part of the story. Prediction markets are no longer a regulatory curiosity. They are infrastructure that raises at fintech scale, with the same institutional due diligence and the same term-sheet dynamics. The capital is treating regulated event-contract platforms as a new asset class, not a gambling wrapper.

Better and Coinbase letting homebuyers pledge Bitcoin for down payments without selling is the other side. Native collateral entering the largest consumer credit market. Not as a novelty product, but as a structural alternative to liquidation. The test is whether the cost of carry and LTV terms can compete with cash down payments when rates are where they are.

What links these: both are bets that crypto assets do not need to exit to traditional rails to become useful. Custody rules that make holding safer. Collateral products that make holding productive. Prediction markets that make holding informed.

The repricing we underwrite on is whether 'infrastructure' now means compliance and custody, or whether it means the layer where native assets interface with existing balance sheets without conversion. Taurus plugging into Swift is a data point for the second read.

If the White House clears the custody overhaul before summer, the timeline compresses further. If it stalls, the gap between what Atkins signaled and what he delivers becomes the story.
